note: GitHub Actions storage is metered for PRIVATE repositories. Two separate
allowances apply and they are not the same pool: artifact storage (shared
with GitHub Packages) and cache storage (separate, 10 GB per repository).
Measured origin 2026-10-17: the fleet hit 'Artifact storage quota has been
hit' and the failing step was always the UPLOAD, never the producing gate.
max_retention_days bounds every upload-artifact step. trim_* bound the
cleanup half: artifacts older than trim_keep_days are deleted EXCEPT the
newest trim_keep_latest per artifact name, so a release or trend artifact
survives age; caches not accessed within cache_max_idle_days are deleted.
Raising a value is a policy decision, not a gate weakening - but it must be
a reviewed edit to this file, never a step that quietly omits its bound.
